note: Source of truth for the analyze-page license gate. 'tier' drives gating: blocked/commercial_restricted tools require the user to have obtained their own license/permission; verify/attribution/permissive do not gate but carry citation or compliance obligations.

tier_definitions.blocked: Academic-only, redistribution FORBIDDEN. The user MUST obtain their own copy/license directly from the provider. Gated.
tier_definitions.commercial_restricted: Free for academic / non-profit use. Commercial use is prohibited or requires separate permission. Gated for commercial users.
tier_definitions.verify: Terms are unclear or vary by sub-component; must be verified with upstream before public redistribution. Surfaced as a caution.
tier_definitions.attribution: Redistribution and commercial use allowed under the license (GPL/AGPL/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA), but citation/attribution and license-chain obligations apply. Not gated.
tier_definitions.permissive: Permissive or public-domain (BSD/MIT/Apache/CC0/US-Gov). No user action. Not gated.
